D: A retired mariachi is pulled back in by a rogue CIA agent to stop a coup in Mexico.
P: Serve the pibil when Agent Sands orders it, again.
S: Day of the Dead concha buns
soft sweet yeasted rolls with a crackly cocoa and vanilla sugar crust, served warm with butter

Soft sweet yeasted buns with a crackly vanilla and cocoa sugar shell scored in a shell pattern, baked golden and served warm with butter. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 80g caster sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml warm milk, 80g soft butter and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and knead 10 minutes. Prove 1 hour, then shape 12 balls. Rub 100g icing sugar, 100g plain flour and 80g butter into a paste, split it and mix cocoa into half. Press a disc onto each bun and score a shell pattern. Prove 40 minutes and bake at 180C for 18 minutes.
Fried tortilla chips with a charred tomato and dried chilli salsa
Corn tortillas cut into wedges and fried crisp, with a salsa of charred tomato, dried chilli, garlic and onion blitzed rough.
Grilled corn brushed with chipotle lime mayo and rolled in feta

Corn cobs grilled until charred, brushed with chipotle and lime mayo, rolled in crumbled feta and finished with chilli powder and coriander. Boil 4 corn cobs for 5 minutes, then grill over high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until charred all over. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 chopped chipotle in adobo and the juice of a lime. Brush the hot corn with the mayo, roll in 100g crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder and chopped coriander. Serve with lime wedges.
M: Pork shoulder marinated in achiote and citrus, wrapped in banana leaves, roasted 4 hours

Pork shoulder marinated overnight in achiote, orange juice, lime, garlic, cumin and oregano, wrapped in banana leaves and foil, roasted at 160C for 4 hours, shredded. Pickled red onion and warm tortillas.
Chicken in red mole with rice
thighs simmered in guajillo, almond, sesame, cinnamon and dark chocolate, over rice, before the coup

Chicken thighs simmered in a rich red mole of dried chillies, tomato, almonds, sesame, cinnamon and dark chocolate, served on rice with toasted sesame. Toast 4 dried guajillo chillies, then soak in 500ml hot chicken stock for 20 minutes. Fry an onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tomatoes, 50g almonds, 2 tbsp sesame seeds and 1 tsp cinnamon. Blitz with the chillies, stock and 40g dark chocolate until smooth. Brown 1kg chicken thighs, pour over the sauce and simmer 40 minutes. Serve on rice with more toasted sesame.
W: Caramel custard flan flavoured with dark chocolate and cinnamon
Caramel poured into ramekins, custard of eggs, milk, cream, dark chocolate and cinnamon on top, baked in a water bath at 150C for 40 minutes, chilled and turned out.
K: Blanco tequila with a chaser of orange, tomato, lime and chilli juice

30ml blanco tequila beside a chaser of orange, lime and tomato juice with a pinch of chilli. Mix 200ml orange juice, the juice of a lime, 100ml tomato juice and a pinch of chilli powder for sangrita. Pour 30ml blanco tequila into each of four glasses with a sangrita chaser alongside.

steps.text: Soak the dried chillies in hot water and cut the tortillas into wedges.
Fry the wedges in oil at 180C in batches until crisp, drain and salt.
Char the tomatoes, chillies, garlic and onion in a dry pan.
Blitz the charred mix rough with salt and serve with the chips.

dishes.make_ahead: Boil the corn and mix the chipotle mayo up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; char the corn and finish just before serving

steps.text: Boil the corn cobs.
Grill over high heat, turning, until charred all over.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle and the juice of one lime.
Brush the hot corn with the mayo, roll in crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder and coriander.
Serve with lime wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Cooks well a day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Mix the achiote with orange and lime juice, garlic, cumin and oregano and coat the pork.
Marinate overnight in the fridge.
Wrap the pork in banana leaves and then foil.
Roast at 160C until it falls apart.
Slice the red onion and quick pickle it in lime juice and salt while the pork rests.
Shred the pork and serve with the pickled onion and warm tortillas.

veg.make_ahead: Cooks well a day ahead, reheat gently

ingredients.item: 565g cans young green jackfruit in brine, drained

steps.text: Squeeze the jackfruit dry and pull it apart with your fingers. Tear the mushrooms into strips.
Mix the achiote with the juice of the oranges and 2 limes, the crushed garlic, cumin, oregano, oil and half the salt and coat the jackfruit and mushrooms.
Marinate for 2 hours in the fridge.
Wrap in banana leaves and then foil and roast at 180C for 1 hour, opening the parcel for the last 15 minutes.
Slice the red onion and quick pickle it in the juice of the last lime and the rest of the salt.
Shred the filling with two forks and serve with the pickled onion and warm tortillas.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep chilled

steps.text: Melt most of the sugar to a golden caramel and pour into four ramekins.
Warm the milk and cream with the chocolate and cinnamon until smooth.
Whisk the eggs with the remaining sugar and whisk in the warm milk.
Strain over the caramel and set the ramekins in a deep tray with hot water.
Bake in the water bath at 150C until just set with a slight wobble.
Chill, then run a knife around the edge and turn out.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the sangrita up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; pour the tequila to serve

steps.text: Mix the orange juice, lime juice, tomato juice and chilli powder for the sangrita.
Pour the tequila into four glasses.
Serve each with a sangrita chaser alongside.

af.make_ahead: Brew and chill the green tea and mix the sangrita up to 1 day ahead; combine and pour to serve

steps.text: Mix the orange juice, juice of one lime, tomato juice and chilli powder for the sangrita.
Stir the green tea with the agave syrup, the salt and a squeeze of lime and pour into four glasses.
Serve each with a sangrita chaser alongside.

s.note: Grilled corn brushed with chipotle lime mayo and rolled in feta

Brush the hot corn with the mayo, roll in 100g crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder and chopped coriander. Serve with lime wedges.

m.note: Pork shoulder marinated in achiote and citrus, wrapped in banana leaves, roasted 4 hours
m.how: Marinate 1.2kg pork shoulder overnight in 50g achiote paste, the juice of 2 oranges and 2 limes, 4 garlic cloves, cumin and oregano. Wrap in banana leaves and foil and roast at 160C for 4 hours. Shred and serve with pickled red onion and tortillas.

w.how: Melt 150g sugar to caramel and pour into 4 ramekins. Warm 400ml milk and 100ml cream with 80g dark chocolate and cinnamon. Whisk into 4 eggs and 80g sugar, pour over and bake in a water bath at 150C for 40 minutes. Chill and turn out.
